checked: Checked the universality and nondiscrimination definition against OHCHR, which states that human rights are inherent to all human beings regardless of nationality, residence, sex, national or ethnic origin, color, religion, language, or other status: https://bangkok.ohchr.org/what-are-human-rights/

Checked state obligations and application in armed conflict against OHCHR, which confirms that international human rights law imposes obligations on States and that human rights apply in peacetime and wartime: https://www.ohchr.org/Documents/Publications/HR_in_armed_conflict.pdf

Checked Articles III, IX, and XIII against the 1987 Constitution. Article III is the Bill of Rights and has Sections 1 through 22; Article IX names CSC, COMELEC, and COA as the Constitutional Commissions; Article XIII Section 17 creates the independent Commission on Human Rights: https://officialgazette.gov.ph/constitutions/1987-constitution/
Solved Example 1 before comparing: the Commission on Human Rights is created under Article XIII.
Solved Example 2 before comparing: human rights law applies in both peacetime and armed conflict, so it does not cease merely because conflict begins.
Solved Example 3 before comparing: Article III is the Philippine Constitution's Bill of Rights and is the intended answer.
